mission: SNKRDUNK recovery (owner 2026-10-30, 'A-only'). Since about 2026-10-29 the SNKRDUNK product page carries its size-chips response in a React Query stream script and makes no price request, so every capture failed prices_not_loaded (seen live on /apparels/93511 and /apparels/142630). The collector now reads that embedded response for the page's own product id, requires every rendered chip to agree with it (listed: same yen price and enabled; unlisted: 出品待ち and disabled), and keeps the network wait only as the fallback. The raw price is the best listed grade with its label, restricted to grade A until a spliced SOURCE_SEMANTICS step can keep B to D out of the index; a page with no grade-A listing is a confident no listing. Log lines carry a readable message. Released to snkrdunk-collector only; no Yuyu-Tei runtime input changes.

impacts.reason: embedded_size_chips/rendered_chip_states/confirm_embedded_prices replace the 15 s wait for a request that no longer happens; any disagreement, ambiguity or unusable payload fails closed (prices_not_loaded with evidence). log_event adds a message key. The infrastructure effect is the mission-scoped release of snkrdunk-collector only. A picker with an unlabelled, double-valued or repeated chip is embedded_dom_incoherent and never extracted (independent review 2026-10-30); a non-success server fetch falls back to the network wait.

RAW_GRADE_PREFERENCE ('A',) replaces the cheapest-grade min(); raw_price_grades_unlisted defines a confident no listing (coherent A-D picker, no grade-A listing) for the due and validate paths. pricing_methodology is assessed false: the owner decided the grade rule on 2026-10-30 (DECISIONS.md), and the index rule change it implies is deferred to a spliced step; SNKRDUNK fed no index input since 2026-10-26. The raw price and the no-listing verdict both require coherent raw grades (raw_labels_coherent).

Live-shaped embedded payloads and chips: read without waiting, nothing-listed reaches extraction, rendered/embedded disagreement and unusable payloads refuse, other products' payloads are ignored, A-only price, no grade-A listing is no listing, readable log line. Fixtures with a cheaper B now expect the A price.

routes: no new source request: the product page is fetched exactly as before; the 15 s price wait no longer runs when the page carries its prices
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback. Behaviour change: SNKRDUNK raw captures resume with grade-A asks; a card with no grade-A listing records no listing; the open retry (mapping 230, nothing listed) records no listing. The 352 blocked items stay blocked until the owner-approved snkr-parser-requeue.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures snkrdunk-collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id is reference only); afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: Captures failing on the new code, a capture whose price differs from the rendered grade-A chip, or any source denial.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change; observations are append-only.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; then mapping 230's next attempt records no listing, and the canary requeue's card captures a grade-A price (work-by-state attempts_24h captured for snkrdunk).
